app.name: Trees vs Breath
app.tagline: Test a street's trees before anyone plants them.
theme.label: Theme
footer.simulated: Every model number in this app is simulated and tagged as such.
start.question: Plant a tree — cooler street or dirtier air?
start.lede: In a narrow Hong Kong street, a tree can shade the pavement and still make the air at your nose dirtier. Test the street before anyone plants.
start.method: AI proposes, physics verifies, the wind tunnel judges.
start.illustration: Illustration of an example street with assumed dimensions. The live simulation arrives in phase 1.
section.title: Cross-section of a street canyon
street.title: Street
street.intro: Choose one of three example streets or enter your own: building height, street width, pavements and compass direction. Phone mode measures them with a compass, a tilt reading and a tape.
design.title: Design
design.intro: Plant, move and resize trees and hedges in the street cross-section, and watch heat and fumes change on each pavement.
tradeOff.title: Trade-off
tradeOff.intro: Every design the AI swept, plotted as heat against fumes. A design on the frontier cannot get cooler without its air getting dirtier.
compare.title: Compare
compare.intro: Up to four designs side by side, with the one we would choose and the reason.
howWeKnow.title: How we know
howWeKnow.intro: The checks behind every number: solver benchmarks, the wind-tunnel reference case, direction checks against published studies, and the AI's accuracy.
leftOut.3d: 3D effects such as junctions, short streets and wind along the street
leftOut.chemistry: NO–NO₂–O₃ chemistry (the fumes are a passive tracer)
hongKong.title: Hong Kong
hongKong.intro: Roadside air quality and summer heat stress in Hong Kong, and how the city already assesses air ventilation for large developments.
report.title: Report
report.intro: A one-page printable summary for a district council or a residents' group.
present.title: Presentation mode
present.intro: A full-screen guided story for the four-minute pitch, stepped with the arrow keys or a clicker.
notFound.title: Page not found
